chapter: Playing New Orleans and the coast
title: Trying to get George Lewis and a bass player Cleo over the lake
summary: He failed to bring George Lewis over the lake; the bass player Cleo was lost to a ship sunk in the war.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: I tried to get him to play with me over the lake once or twice. When his wife, he married one of my cousins, the first wife, would die. Janette. Yeah. And I couldn't get him to come over the lake. Just for one night and get him. I tried to get this old boy Cleo. You know Cleo, the bass player? I heard about him, but he died before I got here. Boy, that was the coming bass player. He could play. He was playing with me. Then, uh... After he... Fooled on you and let's sit in the desk. I don't have no time for that kid. Fooled that boy. Made him stay here. Wouldn't let him come over the lake. I wanted to come over there in 41. On a regular job. Five years and five months. And he wouldn't let the boy... fool that boy. Stay here with him. Fooled on that old big band. He wasn't playing but a couple of nights. Week. Maybe about once. Twice a week. Then after he got disgusted he couldn't make no money, he gets out there and grabs a ship. Now he gonna go on the ship. Marine. And went out there. Time he got out there and them Japanese sunk it. He lost his soul.
